atlas_home_region_card.compact: Gospel-fired southern R&B with grit, horns, and studio-band heat.
atlas_home_region_card.standard: It gave soul music a rawer counterweight to Motown polish and shaped rock, funk, and modern R&B vocal ideals.
atlas_home_region_card.deep: Gospel-fired southern R&B with grit, horns, and studio-band heat. It gave soul music a rawer counterweight to Motown polish and shaped rock, funk, and modern R&B vocal ideals.

region_scene_page.compact: Southern soul took shape through Memphis and Muscle Shoals studios where church-trained voices met hard-working rhythm sections and horn arrangements.
region_scene_page.standard: Southern soul took shape through Memphis and Muscle Shoals studios where church-trained voices met hard-working rhythm sections and horn arrangements. Etta James' I'd Rather Go Blind, Green Onions - Booker T. & the M.G.'s, Wilson Pickett's In the Midnight Hour, and Sam & Dave's Hold On, I'm Comin' give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Southern soul took shape through Memphis and Muscle Shoals studios where church-trained voices met hard-working rhythm sections and horn arrangements. The records feel live, sweaty, and vocally urgent even when the writing is tightly crafted. Etta James' I'd Rather Go Blind, Green Onions - Booker T. & the M.G.'s, Wilson Pickett's In the Midnight Hour, and Sam & Dave's Hold On, I'm Comin' give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
